text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Did you see thaaat?! This is what I'm 
capable of!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was a magnificent run, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be cheering for you next time too! 
Counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll definitely win the 
next one too...

With that, Tokai Teio thrust two fingers 
up toward the sky.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show everyone I can become a 
"Triple Crown Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You can make it happen, Teio! Go for 
it--!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! I won! In the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Amazing, right?! With this, I'm one 
step closer to the President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Having made it this far, I ab-so-lutely 
have to become a Triple Crown Umamusume!

With the momentum Tokai Teio has right 
now, the Triple Crown is by no means a 
dream...!
choice_data_list: Let's win the Kikuka Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Starting tomorrow, I'll train super 
hard for the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... Maybe I got a little tired. My 
legs got all tangled up.
choice_data_list: First, let's get some good rest.

text_block_list.text:
"In the prestigious Classic races, Tokai 
Teio has magnificently claimed two 
crowns."

Aiming for the glorious feat of becoming a 
"Triple Crown Umamusume," she takes on the 
third Classic race, the Kikuka Sho!
